waterfall.desc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.

waterpledge.desc: Use with Grass or Fire Pledge for added effect.

waterspout.desc: Less power as user's HP decreases. Hits foe(s).

whirlwind.desc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.

wish.desc: Next turn, 50% of the user's max HP is restored.

wonderroom.desc: For 5 turns, all Defense and Sp. Def stats switch.

workup.desc: Raises the user's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1.

yawn.desc: Puts the target to sleep after 1 turn.

zenheadbutt.desc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.
